description: Horizontally centered, max-width-constrained container with side gutters. Attribute form: data-layout="center".

attributes.name: data-layout-max
attributes.description: Max inline size of the content box (box-sizing: content-box; the gutter is added outside): narrow (--content-narrow, 40rem), normal (--content-normal, 60rem), wide (--content-wide, 80rem) or prose (65ch).

attributes.name: data-layout-intrinsic
attributes.description: Center narrower-than-max content intrinsically (flex column, align center).

attributes.name: data-layout-gutter
attributes.description: Inline padding on each side: none, s or l. The default --size-m applies when the attribute is omitted; there is no m value. The box is content-box, so the gutter adds to the max width.

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Become a full-width flex column (inline-size fills the parent minus the gutters) with this gap between children, on the shared size scale. Bare attribute = m.
